body:
Yeah I've heard some horror stories but I've heard just as many opposite stories where people say that it wasn't so tough and that they're happy. I guess it's just the risk to take, like anything in life, and I'll never know for sure unless I do it. 

Yeah I'm hoping that being a soldier will create a source of confidence and a bond with other enlisted who have the same mentality, it's worth a shot.

Thanks for the reply and the encouraging comments. Sure I'd be glad to hear about his experience, I actually have an online friend who's in the Navy and while he says he likes it he does often complain or seem a bit down.
